source.author: vnglst
source.text:
Jack lost his job as a software engineer to AI. To provide for his young family he takes a job as a lumberjack in Finland. The pay is good, the work engaging. It's good to be out in nature and work with his hands. He didn't ask what the land is for. With two kids, you don't ask.

A fun automation game in plain JavaScript, inspired by my memories of Warcraft (1994), Stardew Valley, the wonderful book Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow by Gabrielle Zevin and a little bit of Monty Python.

Source: https://github.com/vnglst/lumber-jack-2026
source.title: Show HN: Lumberjack – a browser game about an engineer who lost his job to AI
